nodes.label: Corpus Atlas Appendix: Top-25 Lists
nodes.rationale: Generated 2026-09-08 by scripts/corpus-atlas/aggregate.mjs; 18 ranked top-25 lists over confirmed NDE videos (n=6304), uap_encounters (n=7017), tier 1-2 uap_vids (n=8394) and the uap_events knowledge base.

nodes.label: Top 25: NDE by Transformation Score
nodes.rationale: 6295 scored videos, range 0-45; ties broken by Greyson total then views.

nodes.label: Top 25: NDE by Greyson Total
nodes.rationale: Range 0-32; 3104 videos score 30+, so the Greyson ceiling saturates and ties are broken by rvnde then views.

nodes.label: Top 25: NDE by Veridical (rvnde) Score
nodes.rationale: 6302 scored videos, range 7-28; top band labelled Exceptional Evidential Strength.

nodes.label: Top 25: Distressing NDEs by Intensity
nodes.rationale: overall_tone=very_negative or journey_nde_type=distressing (n=266); dominated by the Touching The Afterlife channel's hell testimonies.

nodes.label: Top 25: Repeat Experiencers (2+ videos)
nodes.rationale: 806 names on 2+ videos, 406 on 3+; exact-string name matching, so spelling variants split one person into several.

nodes.label: Top 25: Multiple-NDE Experiencers (summary regex)
nodes.rationale: Heuristic regex on summaries (n=468); heavily populated by the Brazilian AFINAL, O QUE SOMOS NOS? channel.

nodes.label: Top List: High Transformation with Low Greyson
nodes.rationale: transformation >= 35 and Greyson <= 15 (n=14); surfaces STEs/SDEs/OBEs where life change happened without a classic NDE.

nodes.label: Top 25: Child Experiencers (heuristic)
nodes.rationale: Age <= 12 parsed by regex from AI summaries (n=623); expect false positives where the age belongs to someone else.

nodes.label: Top 25: UAP Encounters by Evidence Score
nodes.rationale: 4843 scored encounters, range 7-26; dominated by military witness cases from Eyes On Cinema.

nodes.label: Top 25: UAP Encounters by Contact Depth
nodes.rationale: 4407 scored encounters, range 0-32; all top 25 hit the ceiling of 32, ties by evidence then views.

nodes.label: Top 25: UAP Encounters by Transformation Score
nodes.rationale: 4845 scored encounters, range 0-56; the top two are NDE-plus-UAP crossover cases.

nodes.label: Top 25: UAP Videos by Views
nodes.rationale: Tier 1-2 uap_vids by view_count; led by Joe Rogan #1315 (66M) and dominated by The Why Files documentaries.

nodes.label: Top 25: Multi-Encounter Videos by encounter_count
nodes.rationale: Tier 1-2 videos with encounter_count >= 2 (n=1023); compilations and documentaries.

nodes.label: Top 25: Under-Oath Claim Videos by intelligence_value
nodes.rationale: has_under_oath_claims=true (n=171); centred on David Grusch testimony and congressional UAP hearings.

nodes.label: Top 25: CE-4 / CE-5 Encounters by Contact Depth
nodes.rationale: hynek_type CE4 or CE5 (n=497); mostly hybrid/abductee interviews from Experiencer Interviews and JeffMara Podcast.

nodes.label: Top 25: Earliest-Dated Encounters (event_year)
nodes.rationale: 3603 encounters with numeric event_year; pre-1900 entries are historical anecdotes retold on channels, not witness interviews.

nodes.label: Top 15: Earliest Events in uap_events Knowledge Base
nodes.rationale: 1939-1963 congressional, crash-retrieval and abduction events (Byrd expedition, National Security Act, Roswell, Robertson Panel, Hill abduction, NSAM 271).

nodes.label: Regex Heuristics on AI Summaries
nodes.rationale: Multiple-NDE and child lists are not coded fields but regex over AI summaries; flagged HEURISTIC with expected false positives.

nodes.label: NDE-UAP Experiencer Crossover
nodes.rationale: Several top UAP-transformation and contact-depth experiencers also report NDEs (Tom Vernon UAP NDE series, Keegan Gill, Carrie Kohan, Chris Bledsoe, Courtney Buterbough).
